intro: A warm climate, a long coastline and a Digital Nomad Visa with a reduced 24% tax rate for 5 years. After 10 years of residency you become eligible for EU citizenship.
climate: Mediterranean along the coast, continental in the interior. Summers reach +30–35°C, with mild winters of +10–15°C in the south and in Barcelona.
mentality: An open, lively culture with a late-night rhythm of life (dinner at 22:00 is the norm). Strong regional identity.
language_note: Castilian (Spanish) is the official language. The regions also use Catalan, Basque and Galician. English is common in tourism and IT.
visa_note: A Schengen visa or residence permit via the DNV, employment or study. The NIE and TIE are mandatory documents for residents. Processing takes 1–2 months.
